title: State an uncertain duplicate-output finding
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
Write a self-contained finding for a new reader. Explain what was observed, what it may mean, and the next check without reporting a confirmed cause.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- A fixture transcript contains two copies of the same tool-result body.
- Only this saved transcript has been examined; the next model request has not been captured.
- Possible explanation: the transcript may include both raw output and a transformed view.
- It is not yet known whether the model received both copies.
- Next check: capture the next model request from the same isolated fixture and compare its tool-result body with the transcript.

literal_check_notice: Advisory exact-evidence diagnostics only. A literal flag cannot decide acceptance or fact preservation. Numeric substring matches can be misleading; a human may mark the semantic fact preserved despite a missing numeric literal (for example, a correctly spelled-out number). Verbatim paths, errors, commands and citations matter where the prompt requests them. All semantic facts and quality ratings require a human.
